name: source-viewer
title: Source viewer
description: Citation chips that open the real source image (slide, scanned page, figure) in a popover beside the text, with Prev/Next.

base.description: Folder (relative to the built pages) holding index.js / index.json and the images. Put the files in static/assets/sources/ so the build copies them.

manifestGlobal.description: Name of the global variable that index.js sets (window.<name> = {decks: …}).

viewer.description: false keeps the chips (same look) but makes them plain labels: no popover and no images, e.g. for a copy published without the source images. The manifest is still read when skipMissing is on, so keep index.js / index.json.

selectors.description: CSS selector of the elements whose text is scanned for citations like "s12" or "s12–14" (see patterns). Empty string turns automatic chips off; explicit .sv-chip / .sv-ref markup still works.

skip.description: Extra CSS selector of elements whose text is never turned into chips (added to the built-in list: code, links, buttons, math, [data-sv-skip] …).

patterns.description: Which citation texts become chips. Each entry: {"prefix": text before the number, "deck": manifest deck id; {page} = the page id (body data-page, or the nearest data-sv-page attribute), {prefix} = the prefix; optional "label": caption label used when the manifest gives the deck none (same fields)}. Longer prefixes win.

pageOverridePrefix.description: Text that lets a citation name another page, e.g. "P03 s12" means s12 of page 03's deck. The page id after it must contain a digit. Empty string disables it.

skipMissing.description: Leave a plain-text citation alone when its deck is not in the manifest (instead of a chip that says the images are missing). Lets one pattern list serve pages that only have some decks.

caption.description: Popover caption. Fields: {deck} {deckLabel} (manifest label, else the deck id) {prefix} {n} {total}.

position.description: Position text between Prev and Next. Fields as in caption.

rangeLabel.description: Badge shown when the chip cites a range; highlighted while the shown frame is inside it. Fields: {prefix} {from} {to}.

singleLabel.description: Badge for a chip that cites one frame (highlighted while that frame is shown); empty = no badge. Fields: {prefix} {from}.

imageLabel.description: Accessible name of the image. Fields as in caption.

error.default: This image could not be loaded.
error.description: Shown when an image fails to load.

missing.default: Images for this source are not available.
missing.description: Shown when the manifest is missing or does not list the deck.

close.description: Accessible name of the close button.

minSideWidth.description: Room (px) needed to place the popover beside the chip; with less room on both sides it goes below (or above) the chip.
